jobs.title: Senior GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Department:
Imerza
Location:
Imerza

Description

Imerza is a global digital twin consultancy partnering with visionary placemakers - developers, architects, and brands - to visualize complex information and data across every stage of the development lifecycle. From concepting to closing and beyond, we deliver measurable value through immersive intelligence: transforming raw geospatial and project data into powerful, real-time 3D environments that drive better decisions.

Imerza is part of the Together Group - a collective of world-class creative and marketing agencies including Noe & Associates, Visualisation One, Purple, Construct, Folk at Purple, HotPot China, and North Six. Together Group brings together specialist expertise across branding, visualisation, communications, and digital experience, giving Imerza access to an unparalleled network of talent and resources to deliver transformative outcomes for clients globally.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage all GIS technical deliverables across multiple projects, ensuring timely, high-quality outputs aligned with client requirements and company standards.
- Oversee the full GIS workflow, from data acquisition and processing to final integration into immersive environments.
- Maintain strict adherence to standardised data structures, schemas, naming conventions, and metadata protocols for all geospatial datasets.
- Develop, implement, and enforce best-practice GIS data management policies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and scalability.
- Perform advanced geospatial data processing, cleaning, transformation, and quality assurance using ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar platforms.
- Prepare and optimise GIS datasets (vector, raster, elevation/DEM, 3D features, and attribute data) for ingestion into Unreal Engine.
- Utilise Unreal Engine tools and plugins (e.g. ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine) to import, geo-reference, and integrate GIS data into real-time 3D environments and digital twins.
- Collaborate closely with Unreal Engine developers, 3D artists, and visualisation teams to troubleshoot geospatial integration issues (coordinate systems, scale, precision, performance optimisation).
- Ensure geospatial accuracy, coordinate reference system alignment, and visual fidelity when translating GIS data into Unreal Engine scenes.
- Manage version control, backups, and archiving of GIS datasets to support project iteration and long-term asset reuse.
- Document GIS processes, data pipelines, and Unreal Engine ingestion workflows to facilitate team knowledge sharing and onboarding.
- Identify and implement opportunities to automate GIS-to-Unreal data pipelines for increased efficiency on large-scale projects.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior GIS team members on data standards, Unreal integration techniques, and project-specific requirements.
- Research and source GIS datasets to support world-building teams.
- Stay current with advancements in GIS technologies, game-engine geospatial tools, and emerging best practices for immersive digital twin development.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:

- Proven senior-level experience in GIS data management, processing, and analysis.
- Deep proficiency with ArcGIS, QGIS, or comparable GIS platforms.
- Hands-on experience integrating GIS data into Unreal Engine, including familiarity with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine or similar geospatial game-engine plugins.
- Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, and geospatial accuracy requirements.
- Experience preparing and optimising vector, raster, DEM/elevation, and 3D feature datasets for real-time 3D environments.
- Ability to develop and enforce data standards, schemas, and documentation across teams.
- Experience with pipeline automation and scripting (Python or similar) for GIS data workflows.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills
- comfortable working cross-functionally with 3D artists, developers, and project managers.
- Experience managing and mentoring junior team members.

Nice to Have:

- Background in real estate, architecture, urban planning, or related property development industries.
- Familiarity with digital twin platforms and immersive visualisation pipelines.
- Experience with game engines beyond Unreal Engine (e.g. Unity).
- Knowledge of BIM data and its integration with GIS environments.

What We Offer

- A globally distributed, collaborative team at the cutting edge of immersive technology.
- Exposure to high-profile, visionary real estate and placemaking projects worldwide.
- The opportunity to shape GIS best practices and build scalable workflows in an innovative, fast-growing consultancy.
- Flexible, remote-first working environment.

About The Role

This position is responsible for driving and leading the comprehensive business application and analytics support for business and finance stakeholders across the organization within Workday Financials and Adaptive Planning.

Leads the administration of the business intelligence platform and related applications, including application development, application strategy, configuration, support, and ad-hoc reporting across multiple functions within the institution. The position leads strategy on reporting, analytics, and data usability, leveraging system configurations and data structures maintained by Workday administrators, while promoting reporting standards, data integrity, and continuous improvement.

Responsible for administering, configuring, and overseeing data analytics and related training activities for the organization's financial systems. Serves as the subject matter expert to develop and leverage Workday Financials and Adaptive cloud application functionalities to improve organizational processes and user functionality of the Workday Financials and Adaptive cloud application. This position leads key aspects of reporting design and data modeling within Workday Financials and Adaptive Planning, translating complex business needs into scalable and reliable insights. This position facilitates collaboration through user groups, stakeholder engagement, and requirements gathering sessions to ensure reporting solutions align with business priorities.

Manages the process to deliver high-quality data analytics, business intelligence services, and reports to the organization.

What You Will Do

Here is a brief summary of what one would expect to be generally responsible for in these roles.

Reporting Design, Configuration, Data Modeling & Governance:

Leads the end-to-end delivery of reporting solutions, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, validation, deployment, documentation, and ongoing enhancement.
Collaborates with senior leaders, Information Technology staff, functional managers, subject matter experts, accounting staff, and other stakeholders to define and implement reporting and analytics requirements.
Translates complex financial and business needs into scalable, accurate, and usable reporting and analytics solutions.
Designs and configures reporting data structures and solutions, including calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, custom objects, prompt sets, and derived data models to support business insight and decision-making.

Applies best practices in data visualization and reporting design to promote clarity, usability, accessibility, and alignment with business objectives.
Establishes and maintains reporting standards, governance practices, business definitions, and common reporting criteria to promote consistency, data integrity, and alignment with institutional and sponsor requirements.
Develops and delivers dashboards, metrics, and analytical tools that provide meaningful and actionable insights for senior leadership and operational teams.
Collaborates with software engineers, data architects, data modelers, and system administrators to incorporate new reporting requirements into underlying data models and system designs.
Leads the development and maintenance of documentation for business definitions, reporting logic, data sources, calculations, and reporting standards.
Partners with OCFO leadership, EIT, and analytics professionals to develop and maintain an organizational data analytics and business intelligence strategy, ensuring financial reporting and analytics remain aligned with the broader strategy.
Represents the function on committees and governance groups related to Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, and associated reporting and analytics capabilities.
Maintains awareness of emerging vendor products, system capabilities, and reporting practices and recommends opportunities to use new functionality to improve reporting, analytics, and business processes.

Application Administration, Support, and Optimization:

Monitors the operation of Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, and related reporting applications and integrations within the position’s area of responsibility.
Troubleshoots complex application, reporting, data, and integration issues; delegates issues when appropriate; and monitors resolution from identification through completion.
Serves as a subject matter expert for identifying, analyzing, and reconciling data and reporting variances within Workday Financials and Adaptive Planning.
Develops a thorough understanding of relevant foundational data models and configurations and partners with system administrators and technical teams to define and implement reporting-related requirements.
Configures reporting and analytics functionality and supports data integrations within the position’s assigned area of responsibility.
Provides guidance to users regarding system functionality, reporting capabilities, data use, and applicable security features, referring security administration decisions to authorized roles as appropriate.
Ensures that documentation for system use, configurations, change requests, enhancements, known issues, and resolutions is maintained and current.
Leads the Adaptive Planning User Group, including establishing agendas, facilitating meetings, documenting decisions and action items, and coordinating follow-up.
Identifies and recommends opportunities to improve user experience, data quality, reporting consistency, system functionality, and business processes.
Coordinates testing and validation of system updates, new functionality, configuration changes, integrations, and reporting enhancements.
Partners with system administrators, Information Technology, vendors, and functional stakeholders to assess issues, evaluate proposed solutions, and implement approved improvements.
Promotes consistent and accurate configuration and use of reports, datasets, dashboards, integrations, and related application functionality.

Leadership, Supervision, and Functional Coordination

Establishes team priorities and coordinates workloads to meet recurring reporting obligations, project deadlines, and emerging business needs.
Reviews reporting, analytics, and system-support deliverables for accuracy, consistency, usability, and compliance with established standards.
Serves as a technical and functional resource to team members, helping resolve complex reporting, data, and application issues and escalating matters when appropriate.
Leads or facilitates cross-organizational working groups for employees performing finance-related work across UCAR, including staff supporting sponsored awards, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis within laboratories and programs.
Provides functional leadership and coordination to working-group participants who do not report to this position, promoting consistent practices, shared standards, effective communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment with institutional financial requirements.
Develops meeting agendas, facilitates discussions, identifies decisions and action items, coordinates follow-up, and elevates cross-functional issues requiring management attention.
Identifies common training, reporting, data, and process needs across decentralized finance-related roles and partners with appropriate stakeholders to develop coordinated solutions.
Communicates relevant OCFO priorities, standards, system changes, and reporting requirements to affected stakeholder groups and gathers feedback regarding operational impacts.

jobs.title: Electrical Systems Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all .

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Summary

The ID1 Facilities Electrical team supports the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of electrical power systems critical to semiconductor manufacturing. The organization is responsible for electrical infrastructure reliability, maintenance execution, operational readiness, documentation control, and continuous improvement activities that help enable safe and uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

The Electrical Systems Program Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of maintenance, reliability, asset management, and compliance programs within the ID1 Electrical Systems organization.

This role serves as a key interface between operations, engineering, reliability, planning, and support organizations to ensure maintenance programs, equipment records, audit requirements, training documentation, and operational processes remain accurate, effective, and aligned with business objectives. The Program Coordinator plays a critical role in driving operational readiness, managing program execution, and improving business processes that support manufacturing reliability and performance.

Responsibilities

Coordinate maintenance planning, asset management, and reliability programs supporting critical electrical infrastructure while ensuring high-volume manufacturing readiness through current maintenance programs, training records, and operational documentation.
Create, maintain, and continuously improve SAP asset data, maintenance plans, equipment records, task lists, and associated documentation to support operational excellence.
Support Total Productive Management (TPM), FMEA, corrective action tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance equipment reliability and operational performance.
Manage document control processes including procedure development, reviews, revisions, approvals, record retention, and document compliance.
Coordinate audit readiness activities, including documentation management, evidence collection, corrective action implementation, and closure tracking to ensure regulatory and operational compliance.
Develop, maintain, and analyze reports, dashboards, scorecards, and key performance metrics to monitor program effectiveness and drive data-based decision-making.
Partner with Facilities, Operations, Engineering, Reliability, and EHS teams to identify program gaps, resolve operational challenges, and implement process improvement opportunities.
Coordinate and track action items related to maintenance, reliability, compliance, and operational improvement initiatives while using approved digital and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, documentation, data analysis, and business process efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications

Associate degree in Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience supporting maintenance, facilities, manufacturing, industrial operations, or business process coordination.
Experience working with SAP PM, CMMS, enterprise asset management, document control, or similar business systems.
Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive actions to completion in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Reliability, Facilities Management, Industrial Technology, or related field.
Experience supporting semiconductor manufacturing, critical facilities, or other high-reliability operations.
Knowledge of TPM, FMEA, root cause analysis, reliability programs, or continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting audits, compliance programs, corrective action management, or operational readiness activities.
Experience with Power BI, KPI reporting, Lean, Six Sigma, reliability initiatives, or project/program coordination.

The ID1 Facilities Electrical team supports the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of electrical power systems critical to semiconductor manufacturing. The organization is responsible for electrical infrastructure reliability, maintenance execution, operational readiness, documentation control, and continuous improvement activities that help enable safe and uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

The Electrical Systems Program Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of maintenance, reliability, asset management, and compliance programs within the ID1 Electrical Systems organization.

This role serves as a key interface between operations, engineering, reliability, planning, and support organizations to ensure maintenance programs, equipment records, audit requirements, training documentation, and operational processes remain accurate, effective, and aligned with business objectives. Coordinate and track action items related to maintenance, reliability, compliance, and operational improvement initiatives while using approved digital and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, documentation, data analysis, and business process efficiency.
